title: Chapter 112 Yuanji Dojo
content:
Chapter 112 Yuanji Dojo

As Lu Daosheng's aura became stronger and stronger, a hazy vortex slowly emerged from the void.

At this moment, the Golden Immortal Realm could no longer bear his breath.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, then pulled Yan Lingyun's little hand and walked towards the vortex.

At this time, Yan Lingyun seemed to have become a good girl, but she just followed Lu Daosheng silently without saying a word.

.........

The sea of darkness.

This is a place without rules.

The true strong are respected.

It is harder for a weak existence to survive here than climbing to the sky.

At the same time, this is also a paradise for those extremely vicious people.

There is a supreme power that after endless years, a powerful man will inevitably appear, and he will unify the entire Nether Sea with a crushing momentum.

And this is also something countless top strong people dream of, because once the entire Nether Sea is unified, the benefits obtained are unimaginable.

Not only can you obtain countless rare resources in the Nether Sea, but you can also gain a large number of strong people to serve you.

In this way, there will inevitably be capital to challenge those supreme forces.

In an ancient building.

"Master Yelou, how are you thinking about what I said?"

A man in a dark golden robe was looking at the silent middle-aged man in front of him with a faint smile.

Ye Lin, one of the top strong men in the Minghai.

The owner of the Eagle Eye Building.

Best at intelligence collection.

At this time, Ye Lin fell into hesitation.

The identity of the man in front of him, who exudes a noble aura, is extremely not simple, and even he is afraid of it.

What the other party talked with him was to cooperate and help each other.

The intention is the entire Nether Sea!

This shocked him, but also felt a little moved.

Because the conditions given by the other party are too high, and once the other party successfully unifies the Nether Sea, his status will become higher, and at that time, he will get more benefits.

However, this fact is a bit risky.

If you fail, you will face the risk of falling. Even if you don’t die, you will be expelled from the sea of darkness.

If you don’t collude with outsiders, you can just solve it internally.

This is the principle of doing things in Minghai.

Will you have a good ending after being expelled from the Nether Sea?

That certainly won't.

After a long silence, Ye Lin shook his head.

"Young Master Chen, let's forget about this. I can pretend that this has never happened. You go."

Ye Lin refused.

There is no way, the risk is too great, so it is better for him to be more stable.

However, Chen Yu smiled slightly, and there was obviously no surprise at all for Ye Lin's rejection.

"Master Yelou, don't worry about refusing."

Chen Yu smiled lightly, then slowly took out two tokens.

Seeing this scene, Ye Lin suddenly widened his eyes and looked at the two tokens in disbelief.

"Young Master Chen, you!"

Chen Yu showed a smug smile and said slowly: "Yes, those two have agreed."

Hearing this, Ye Lin felt the trace of original breath in the two tokens and took a deep breath.

If so.

"Okay, Mr. Chen, this matter is me!"

Ye Lin spoke decisively.

The reason why he rejected Chen Yu was because the success rate was too small.

To unite several top-level powerhouses with high power in the Nether Sea to jointly suppress the remaining forces of all sizes and large in the Nether Sea, the consequence of this is that they will have more resources.

After all, although there are abundant resources in the Netherworld, they are limited after all.

Who would think there are many resources?

Chen Yu not only promised to give them a lot of benefits, but more importantly, Chen Yu just established an alliance. As the nominal leader, he had no real power.

This is what makes him most excited.

Of course, Chen Yu is not a fool either.

His condition is that when he needs help in the future, the entire Nether Sea must do his best to help.

This condition is not difficult for them.

Now that even those two people agreed, it means that this matter is almost certain.

So Ye Lin agreed decisively.

At this time, Chen Yu immediately smiled.

"That night, I wish us a happy cooperation."

Chen Yu stretched out his hand to Ye Lin and spoke.

"Okay, happy cooperation."

In this way, the two shook hands and formed an alliance, and the alliance was officially established.

Next, the entire Nether Sea suddenly began to restless.

......

"Lingyun, where are you from?"

In a gorgeous sea of stars, Lu Daosheng pulled Yan Lingyun to walk through it.

At this time, countless starlights around were deliberately avoiding Lu Daosheng.

Because Lu Daosheng's current aura is really too terrifying, it seems that he does not belong here.

Yan Lingyun was a little hesitant when she heard Lu Daosheng's words.

"Daosheng, what do you want to do?"

Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "It's nothing, I just want to see where you have lived."

With his current strength, he can easily deduce where Yan Lingyun comes from.

But he didn't do that.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun whispered, "Can you do it in the future?"

Seeing Yan Lingyun's expression a little low, Lu Daosheng pursed his lips and then smiled and said, "Okay."

"Daosheng."

At this time, Yan Lingyun suddenly looked up at Lu Daosheng.

"Are all you said before true?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded without hesitation and said, "Of course."

What he meant was the invincibility that Lu Daosheng said.

At first, Yan Lingyun thought that Lu Daosheng was just being stubborn, but now, she also believed it a little.

From the True Self Realm, he has been improving without any bottlenecks. Now, Lu Daosheng's strength has even been comparable to her peak strength.

And Lu Daosheng seems to be able to continue to improve.

Although she knew that Lu Daosheng would say this, Yan Lingyun still felt a little surprised.

The man she had always wanted to protect suddenly became invincible, which made her feel very complicated.

At this moment, a dojo standing in the sea of stars suddenly appeared in the direction of the two people.

Seeing this scene, Yan Lingyun was shocked.

"What is it?"

Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, "Yuanji Dojo, you should know that person."

Hearing the place of Yuanji Dojo, Yan Lingyun suddenly had a shortness of breath.

This is the place she had been looking for all the time, because the owner of this place is the strongest existence she has known.

The Source Supreme!

An existence known as the Creator.

With his own strength, he created countless order halls and maintained the order and balance of the heavens and the worlds.

According to legend, in the Source Dojo, there is the power to change the world.

And now, Lu Daosheng actually brought her to the Source Dojo.

Thinking that she was about to meet the Source Supreme, Yan Lingyun suddenly became a little nervous and held Lu Daosheng's hand tightly.

Feeling the strength in his hand, Lu Daosheng laughed in his heart.

Finally, he made himself stand out in front of his wife, but the good show is still to come.
